rules.rule_name: Data Encryption at Rest and in Transit
rules.explanation: Storing sensitive databases, object storage buckets, or transmitting traffic without strict encryption exposes data to interception and compliance breaches.
rules.do: Enforce TLS/HTTPS for all data in transit and configure automated server-side encryption (e.g., using AWS KMS or customer-managed keys) for all data at rest.
rules.dont: Do not leave public-facing cloud storage buckets unencrypted or allow unencrypted HTTP traffic to backend workloads.

rules.rule_name: Automated Cloud Security Posture Management and Auditing
rules.explanation: Failing to continuously monitor cloud resource configurations leads to undetected permission leaks, open security groups, and compliance drift.
rules.do: Enable automated cloud audit logging (e.g., AWS CloudTrail), configuration compliance rules (e.g., AWS Config), and regular vulnerability scans.
rules.dont: Do not rely on manual security checkups or leave cloud audit trails disabled on production accounts.

rules.rule_name: Proactive FinOps and Cloud Cost Optimization
rules.explanation: Leaving idle compute instances, unattached storage volumes, and over-provisioned resources running indefinitely results in massive financial waste.
rules.do: Implement FinOps practices: set up budget alerts, automate resource shutdown schedules for non-production environments, and clean up unattached EBS volumes and elastic IPs.
rules.dont: Do not provision oversized cloud instances without reviewing actual CPU/memory metrics or leave non-production environments running 24/7.

rules.rule_name: Lifecycle Tagging and Resource Cost Allocation
rules.explanation: Deploying untagged cloud resources makes it impossible to attribute cloud expenditures accurately across teams, projects, or environments.
rules.do: Enforce mandatory tagging policies (e.g., Owner, Environment, Project) on all cloud resources created via IaC or console.
rules.dont: Do not deploy untagged infrastructure resources that obscure cost attribution and resource ownership.
